reference_sql:
WITH export_media AS (
  -- one row per first-touch medium: the purchase events of 1 to 31 December 2025 (Dublin days)
  SELECT traffic_source.medium AS medium, COUNT(*) AS export_purchases
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
  GROUP BY traffic_source.medium
), first_paid AS (
  -- one row per subscription: when its first payment came in, refunded or not
  SELECT subscription_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY subscription_id
), december_buyers AS (
  -- one row per subscription whose first payment fell on a Dublin day of December 2025, with the visitor who signed up
  SELECT f.subscription_id, g.visitor_id
  FROM first_paid f
  JOIN subscriptions sub ON sub.subscription_id = f.subscription_id
  JOIN signups g ON g.user_id = sub.user_id
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', f.first_paid_at), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
), first_starts AS (
  -- one row per such visitor: the start of the visitor's first session
  SELECT s.visitor_id, MIN(s.session_start) AS first_start
  FROM sessions s
  WHERE s.visitor_id IN (SELECT visitor_id FROM december_buyers)
  GROUP BY s.visitor_id
), backend_media AS (
  -- one row per first-session medium: December's first payments, a missing utm_medium read as (none)
  SELECT COALESCE(s.utm_medium, '(none)') AS medium, COUNT(*) AS backend_first_payments
  FROM december_buyers d
  JOIN first_starts f ON f.visitor_id = d.visitor_id
  JOIN sessions s ON s.visitor_id = f.visitor_id AND s.session_start = f.first_start
  GROUP BY COALESCE(s.utm_medium, '(none)')
)
SELECT COALESCE(e.medium, b.medium) AS medium,
  COALESCE(e.export_purchases, 0) AS export_purchases, COALESCE(b.backend_first_payments, 0) AS backend_first_payments,
  COALESCE(e.export_purchases, 0) - COALESCE(b.backend_first_payments, 0) AS difference
FROM export_media e
FULL JOIN backend_media b ON b.medium = e.medium

solver.query:
WITH fp AS (
  SELECT f.subscription_id, sb.user_id
  FROM (SELECT subscription_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at, arg_min(amount_eur, paid_at) AS first_amount FROM payments GROUP BY subscription_id) f JOIN subscriptions sb ON sb.subscription_id = f.subscription_id
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', f.first_paid_at), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
), su AS (
  SELECT user_id, visitor_id FROM signups WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM fp)
), fs AS (
  SELECT visitor_id, utm_source, utm_medium
  FROM (
    SELECT s.visitor_id, s.utm_source, s.utm_medium,
      row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.visitor_id ORDER BY s.session_start) AS rn
    FROM sessions s
    WHERE s.visitor_id IN (SELECT visitor_id FROM su)
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
e AS (
  SELECT traffic_source.medium AS medium, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
  GROUP BY 1
), b AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(fs.utm_medium, '(none)') AS medium, COUNT(*) AS c
  FROM fp LEFT JOIN su ON su.user_id = fp.user_id
  LEFT JOIN fs ON fs.visitor_id = su.visitor_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(e.medium, b.medium) AS medium, COALESCE(e.c, 0) AS export_purchases,
  COALESCE(b.c, 0) AS backend_first_payments, COALESCE(e.c, 0) - COALESCE(b.c, 0) AS difference
FROM e FULL JOIN b ON e.medium = b.medium
